item.title: URI receives record $2M athletic endowment; renames football practice field
item.description: SOUTH KINGSTOWN – The University of Rhode Island has received a $2 million gift from alumni Mark S. Cruise and his wife, Sue, establishing a new athletic endowment and securing naming rights to the school’s football practice field. item.title: McKee’s approval rating climbs in latest Morning Consult poll
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The most recent Morning Consult poll released Tuesday shows Gov. Daniel J. McKee’s approval rating climbing to 49%, a significant improvement from his last-in-the- nation rating in the previous quarter. item.title: Foulkes doubles McKee in Q4 gubernatorial campaign fundraising
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The campaign for Democratic gubernatorial challenger Helena Buonanno Foulkes pulled in $576,117 in the fourth quarter of 2025 – more than double incumbent Gov. Daniel J. McKee’s $213,000 haul. Foulkes finished the quarter strong, topping the $534,000 she raised in the previous quarter, while McKee’s fundraising slipped from the $294,813 that he raised […]

item.title: German biotech company to establish U.S. headquarters in Providence
item.description: PROVIDENCE – A German biotech company is set to establish its U.S. headquarters in the capital city. Repairon GmbH, a company working to develop new regenerative heart failure treatments, announced this week that it will launch a subsidiary, Repairon USA, to lead company efforts throughout North America. item.description: PROVIDENCE – Banco Santander S.A., the Madrid-based parent of Santander Holdings USA Inc. and Santander Bank N.A., announced Tuesday it will acquire Webster Financial Corp., the Stamford, Conn.-based parent of Webster Bank, in a cash-and-stock transaction valued at approximately $12.3 billion.
